patthana23.4:1.1: na kusalaṃ na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. akusalāneva tīṇi.
patthana23.4:2.1: na kusalaṃ na asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
